messages.subject: Prior distribution
parts:
Please, I would like to know the default a priori distribution of the coefficients in the INLA function? what is the option to modify this default a priori distribution?

For example, below my model. 


formula <- inla.surv(times, status) ~ 0 + a0 + age + sexe + traitement + f(spatial, model=spde)

ModelSPDE <- inla(formula, family="weibullsurv", data=inla.stack.data(stk), control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk)),
                             control.compute = list(dic=TRUE,mlik=TRUE),verbose=TRUE,control.inla = list (strategy = "laplace",h=0.00001))


Bests regards
